propositions: Three detached-child spawn sites independently re-implement identical logic (PYTHONPATH bootstrap, detach flags, stdio discipline, cwd handling), causing defects to replicate across all three when one is introduced.
Bug 3198 (missing cwd= on Popen) existed at all three sites due to copy-paste imitation across separate commits, demonstrating structural risk of duplicated patterns.
A single spawn_detached() helper in _proc.py consolidates the one correct implementation while preserving per-caller exception handling, env construction, and logging posture.

The static test suite now enforces that detached-spawn signature tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, sys.path.insert re-entry bootstrap) appear only in _proc.py, catching future copy-paste sites.
Long-lived in-process callers (daemon threads, reconcilers) accept the raising posture of repo_root's cwd fallback; detached children no longer reach it via explicit durable cwd.
